title: Four Chariots and one lion: your 2027

article.title: Four Chariots and one lion: your 2027
article.lead: The Chariot appears on your chart four times — you are a person of speed and drive. And in the centre of 2027 stands Strength, which your personal matrix doesn’t have at all. The Chariot wins by momentum, Strength by endurance, and the whole year tests whether you can hold yourself and your work without pressure. Below: the matrix of the year according to Yuliana Lisovskaya’s book on forecasts, three thirds, twelve months, love, money and a plan. This is a symbolic reading for self-knowledge and planning, not a prediction of events and not a psychological diagnosis.
summary: **The background of the year is Strength.** According to Lisovskaya, the centre of the year’s matrix sets the tone for every month. The habit of winning by speed costs a lot this year; endurance pays off.

**The money risk zone is the Wheel, twice.** It occupies both minus points of the year: impulsive decisions, debts, old scenarios. The Wheel is your main talent, and the chance will go to the one who is prepared.
**The strong side is the Lovers, the support is the Hermit.** The year favours alliances, contracts, choice and time alone with yourself. From April the Lovers also stand on your age ring.

**The weak spot is the Tower.** Abrupt decisions on emotion, burnt bridges. Until April the Tower also stands on the ring: rebuilding according to a plan is fine, breaking things in the heat of the moment is not.
**Money in focus.** The hint of the year, Justice, is the main point of your material karma. Judgement, which shows what the year is good for, stands in your point of profit.

**Three thirds: Judgement, the Emperor, the Lovers.** Winter and spring sum up earlier decisions, summer is for building and consolidating, autumn brings a choice that, according to the book, grows out of the first two thirds.
**Preparing for forty.** Justice will open your decade from 40 to 50, and the Wheel is your social purpose, which according to Lisovskaya comes into force between the ages of 37 and 43.

chapters.h2: Key of the year: Strength in the hands of the Chariot
chapters.conclusion: 2027 rests on Strength: endurance brings results, while pressure costs dearly. The Wheel in both minus points warns that in money and trials the year doesn’t like bets on luck and readily accepts a prepared chance. It is also the year before forty: it rehearses what will become the main thing after it.

blocks.h3: The main idea of the year

blocks: In 2026 the centre of your year’s matrix was 7, the Chariot — your own energy, which also occurs more often than any other on your personal chart. Such a year pays for speed: whoever decided faster got there. In 2027 the centre is taken by 11, Strength, and that is a change of rules. According to Yuliana Lisovskaya’s book, the centre of the year’s matrix is responsible for the main events and the general background: what to expect in the plus and in the minus and what to watch most closely. Strength in this role is an energy of workload: organisation, leadership, patience, recovery. The full list of its pluses and minuses from the book is in the next chapter.

The year promises a lot of work and a lot of responsibility, and it tests one thing: what you carry this load with. You can carry it with pressure — then the minus of Strength comes by itself: people resist, the body gets tired, and in an argument you win while the work loses. You can carry it with endurance — then the same load adds up to a result, and by December you have a manageable system in your hands rather than a fire to put out.

Waite describes these two cards so that they almost argue. His charioteer’s victory is external: he has solved the riddle of nature but is still bound by reason, and all his achievements lie outside. Waite’s Strength is a higher nature that has already tamed the passions: a woman closes the lion’s jaws, the lion is subdued and walks on a chain of flowers, and Waite calls this chain the light yoke of a law accepted in the depth of the heart. He explicitly refuses to see ordinary “self-confidence” in this card. For a person with four Chariots the image is transparent: the Chariot has speed, and the year gives you a reason to also learn to tame it — that is, to stop, hold back and steer.

formula.caption: **7 → 11 → 8.** Three years in a row: speed, endurance, calculation. The Chariot of 2026 matched your main energy; the Justice of 2028 will match your material task and the decade after forty. 2027 is the bridge between them, and the skill it gives will be needed on the other side.

blocks.h3: Three meetings of the year with your matrix

blocks: When an arcanum of the year matches an arcanum on your chart, that in itself predicts nothing. It shows where the year doesn’t enter as a stranger: the places where you already have experience with this energy.

formula.caption: **10 = 10.** The Wheel occupies both minus points of the year’s matrix, the material one and the lower one. For you it is your main talent — a sense of the moment. And it is also your social purpose, which according to the book switches on between the ages of 37 and 43.

blocks: Lisovskaya calls both these points the pure minus of the year and advises reading them together, first in the minus, then in the plus. The minus of the Wheel is repetition: old scenarios, impulsive decisions, debts; the plus is opportunities and luck (in detail — in the next chapter). The result is a fork: for a person who senses the moment, the year tests exactly this gift. A chance you prepared for is supported by this year. A leap in the hope of getting lucky risks turning into an old scenario — that is the minus of the Wheel.

formula.caption: **8 = 8.** The sum of all nine points of the year — the hint to the year as a whole — matches the main point of your material karma. The sum changes from year to year, and in 2027 it landed exactly here.

blocks: The last two meetings are both about money. The hint of the year points to your material karma, the corner “what the year is good for” to the point from which, according to Lisovskaya, the biggest earnings come. In September a third will join them: the centre of the month will match your entrance to money. The conclusion is simple: 2027 tests how you handle the material from several sides at once. In detail — in the chapter on money.

blocks.h3: What kind of person the year finds

blocks: The year comes to a person noticeable for speed: the Chariot stands in your personality portrait, in your karmic task, in the middle of the line of talents and in the point where money and relationships meet. Inside, in the centre, is 5, the Hierophant: rules, tradition, a habit of explaining and teaching, a firm sense of “how it should be”. And in her book on karmic tails Lisovskaya describes the karmic tail 12 → 19 → 7 as the task of a person who is constantly drawn into clashes: to learn to hear the other side, settle conflict with words, move towards a goal consistently and without trampling others. It looks as if 2027 has taken this task and made it a theme for twelve months: Strength in the centre is exactly the skill the tail expects of you.

blocks.h3: What the year asks in practice

ul: **In negotiations.** You see a favourable outcome and want to push it through. The year of Strength advises stating your terms once, calmly, and holding the pause. Whoever fills the silence first usually gives way.

**At work.** A project you want to take in a two-week sprint is better spread into an even ten-week pace, and kept to it. Strength in a forecast means “many projects”, and they can only be sustained at a pace that doesn’t burn you out.

**In an argument at home.** It seems to you that you are right, and perhaps you are. But the tail and the centre of the year agree on one thing: this year, being right achieved by pressure costs more than being right put off for a day.
**In money.** An offer that looks like luck and demands a decision today is exactly the case the Wheel in the minus warns about. A prepared chance usually doesn’t require a decision “today”.

blocks: The freedom here is entirely yours. The year’s matrix shows which forces will be at hand and where the forks lie. You can live 2027 at your usual speed, and it is unlikely to become a failure — it will simply spend energy on friction. Or you can use it as the year you master a second way of steering: and then by forty you will have two tools instead of one.
actions: Choose one undertaking for the whole year that you will run at an even pace, and once a month write down what it has given you.
Before money decisions in 2027, ask yourself: am I preparing a chance or waiting for luck?
Keep a twelve-line journal of the year: one line per month — what you held on to and what you let go.

chapters.h2: The matrix of 2027: nine points and a hint
chapters.conclusion: The background of the year is Strength, the plus is the Lovers and the Hermit, the minus is the Wheel twice, the weak spot is the Tower. With people the year asks for the breadth of the World, and it is strongest in summing up earlier undertakings (Judgement) and in building a stable order (the Emperor). The hint to the whole year is Justice: honest calculation and making things official.

cards.label: Upper point of the year — the plus
cards.caption: The strong side of 2027: partnership, contracts, choice. From April the Lovers also stand on your age ring.

cards.label: Upper right corner of the year — the weak spot
cards.caption: What is better postponed and what throws you off: decisions in the heat of the moment, burnt bridges, rebuilding without a plan.

blocks: The year’s matrix isn’t on the chart above the report: it is built separately, and you see it only here. The calculation method is from Lisovskaya’s book “Prognostics”. The year gets a notional date: the day is the sum of all the days of the year (365 → 3 + 6 + 5 = 14), the month is the sum of the year’s digits plus twelve (2 + 0 + 2 + 7 = 11, 11 + 12 = 23), the year stays the year. This date is added to yours: day 7 + 14 = 21, month 10 + 23 = 33 → 6, year 1988 + 2027 = 4015 → 10. The other points are sums of neighbouring ones, as in an ordinary matrix. In a forecast the plus is read from the upper point and the upper left corner, the minus from the right and lower points; the centre and the upper right corner influence the whole matrix and are read together with other points.

blocks.h3: Centre: 11 Strength — the background of all twelve months

blocks: According to Lisovskaya, the centre of the year’s matrix means the main events and the general background, plus and minus at once. The plus of Strength in her list: organisation, leadership, control, patience, recovery, exams and competitions, many projects. The minus: aggression and conflicts, workaholism, obsession, burnout, manipulation, delays with documents. Strength isn’t on your chart, and that is the main feature of the year: the tool is new, and you will have to master it from scratch. In “Destiny Matrix for Beginners” Lisovskaya advises people of this energy to understand what the potential of their strength is directed at — creation or destruction, to watch their voice and speech, not to coerce and to learn to rest. For the year this is a ready-made instruction: watch your tone, don’t issue ultimatums, rest on a schedule without waiting until your strength runs out.

What it looks like in life: more people and more tasks than usual are entrusted to you, and you want to take everything into your own hands. Strength approves of leadership where people follow you without coercion. If leadership resembles a gallop, Strength has its own minus — burnout and resistance from those you lead.

blocks.h3: Upper point: 6 the Lovers — the strong side of the year

blocks: Lisovskaya calls the upper point the positive characteristic of the year: what to pay attention to, through what to show yourself, which ideas take priority. The Lovers in a forecast mean new relationships and acquaintances, partnership, help from outside, a proposal, co-creation, a lot of choice, choosing a profession, concluding deals and contracts, material support from outside, a change of image, style and surroundings. The key word here is “together”. The year is stronger where you do something with someone: reach agreement, join forces, choose an ally. For a Chariot person used to driving out in front, this is an interesting turn: in 2027 the win more often lies in an alliance than in a solo dash.

The Lovers also have choice in the narrow sense: a fork where you have to decide with whom and where to go. The year offers many options, and the plus of this point works when the choice is made and formalised. An eternal “we’ll see” turns an abundance of options into fatigue.

blocks.h3: Upper left corner: 9 the Hermit — what to lean on

blocks: The upper left corner is the inspiring part of the year: what to lean on, where to show and realise yourself. The Hermit in a forecast means time for yourself, stability, a holiday, remote work or freelancing, a new hobby, self-knowledge, self-sufficiency, study, personal boundaries, awareness of your path and concentration on one thing. The support of the year is silence and focus. This combines well with Strength in the centre: endurance grows where a person has a place nobody enters without knocking. In practice this means your 2027 schedule should contain hours that belong only to you, and one main undertaking you give your best time to.

The Lovers and the Hermit side by side look like a contradiction: one plus is about alliance, the other about solitude. In fact they work as a pair. An alliance is stronger for someone who entered it not running away from loneliness but by choice. The Hermit gives clarity about with whom and why, the Lovers give the alliance itself.

blocks.h3: Right and lower points: 10 the Wheel twice — the minus of the year

blocks: The right point is responsible for the material: finances, prospects, what unpleasant things may happen in this area and how to react. The lower one is responsible for the trials of the year: which tasks you will have to go through, which negative actions we may take, what to think about and what to change. Lisovskaya allows reading them together, and for you both are occupied by one card — the Wheel. This is the main repetition of the year’s matrix.

The minus of the Wheel is repetition. Old scenarios return, people from the past reappear, a decision made on emotion triggers a chain of consequences, debts and loans seem convenient, and trust goes to someone who didn’t earn it. All these minuses are about the absence of a pause between impulse and action. The Wheel in the minus spins whoever didn’t manage to stop. And Strength in the centre is exactly the ability to stop. The year is built so that its background provides the cure for its own main minus.

For you the Wheel is your main talent, the point above the whole chart. This explains why the minus of the year may feel sharp: it hits what you are usually proud of, your instinct for the moment. In 2027 instinct is worth checking with calculation. “I feel I should” is a reason to sit down and do the maths, not a reason to sign.

blocks.h3: Left point: 21 the World — how to behave with people

blocks: According to the book, the left point shows how to interact with the world: what is expected of you, what you can give others, what mistakes towards yourself and people to beware of. The World in a forecast means travel, a move, fame, interesting projects, meetings with loved ones, freedom of expression, help, learning a language or another culture, “all roads are open”. Its minus is restrictions, postponed trips, conflicts, irresponsibility and external circumstances that can’t be influenced. In 2027 breadth is expected of you: to see beyond your own patch, to connect people from different places, to take on what goes beyond the usual limits. The mistake of this point is to promise more than circumstances allow and then make excuses with external reasons.

This point depends only on your birthday and on whether the year is a leap year, so in any ordinary year you have 21 here; in the leap year 2028 it will be 22. The match with your “attitude to the material”, which is also 21, is a constant note of your years: the world around you keeps asking how freely you handle money and things.

blocks.h3: Upper right corner: 16 the Tower — the weak spot

blocks: Lisovskaya calls the upper right corner the negative aspect: what not to do, what to postpone, what news throws you off. She specifically notes that this point is neither good nor bad — it shows our weaknesses in front of others. The Tower in the minus means destruction, crisis, cancelled plans, unjustified risk, urgent forced decisions, failed deals. Its plus is on the list too: renovation, rebuilding, renewal, leaving what has outlived itself. The weak spot of the year is the wish to tear everything down at once when something doesn’t suit you. Saying something harsh, slamming the door, quitting in the heat of the moment, breaking up in a fit of anger — in this position the Tower advises putting such moves off at least until morning.
Until April the Tower also stands on your age ring. The first third of the year is when this weak spot sounds loudest; we will come back to it in the chapter on age and in January–April.

blocks.h3: Lower corners: 20 Judgement and 4 the Emperor — what the year is good for

blocks: According to the book, the lower corners show what the year is good for and what to beware of in it. In the lower right corner is 20, Judgement: past actions bring results, meetings with relatives, transformation, searching for a new occupation, expansion, fast changes. Beware of people and situations from the past, serious quarrels with relatives, loss of control, a difficult choice. Judgement also stands in your point of profit, so the year is good for harvesting long-standing investments — knowledge, connections, reputation.

In the lower left corner is 4, the Emperor: ambition, promotion, opening a business, an offer of a good position, help from an influential person, stability, solving problems successfully, planning a move or a long trip. Beware of conflicts and rivalry, inspections, instability and “situations developing fast”. The Emperor is a builder of order: the year is good for consolidating a structure, taking responsibility and establishing yourself as the master of your own area. The Emperor’s minus rhymes with the minus of Strength: rivalry for power. You can become master of your area without fighting for the throne.

blocks.h3: The hint of the year: 8 Justice

blocks: Lisovskaya suggests not writing the sum of all nine points anywhere and keeping it as a hint to the year. For you it is 8, Justice — the main point of your material karma. In another system, the Golden Dawn correspondences cited by Benebell Wen, it is also the card of your sign, Libra; this has nothing to do with the matrix method, but the coincidence is a nice one. In a forecast Justice means the results of work, official registration, signing contracts, compensation, getting back what you need, organisation. Its minus is litigation, failed deals, fines and debts, papers signed without attention. The hint sounds simple: in 2027 what isn’t written down and formalised doesn’t hold well. Agreed — record it. Earned — count it. Hurt — name exactly what by.

blocks.h3: The path of Strength: 2026 → 2027 → 2028

blocks: Strength doesn’t appear in your years suddenly. In the matrix of 2026 it was already there — in the lower left corner, which is read for what the year is good for and what to beware of. In 2027 it moves to the centre and becomes the background of all twelve months. In 2028 it will occupy two points at once: the upper left corner, the support of the year, and the right one, the material point. The result is a path from the corner to the centre and on to the foundation: first a hint, then the main theme, then a skill you rely on and that tests how you handle money.

It is useful to check this against the 2026 you have lived through. Its centre was your Chariot, and the plus held your centre, the Hierophant, and Justice: the year spoke your language and supported your usual way of acting. If in 2026 there were moments when speed began to cost more than it brought — when you had to hold back, be patient, take a blow without answering — that was the corner of Strength. In 2027 such moments will become the rule of the year, and the experience of 2026 will come in handy.

blocks.h3: How the points add up

blocks: If you read the matrix as one story, it goes like this. The background is Strength: a lot of work and endurance as the way to carry it. The support is the Hermit: silence and one main undertaking. The strong side is the Lovers: alliance and choice. The risk is the Wheel in money and trials: repeating the old and deciding on impulse. The weak spot is the Tower: tearing things down in the heat of the moment. With people — the World: breadth and responsibility for what was promised. The year is good for summing up (Judgement) and for building order (the Emperor). And the hint is Justice: everything that matters must be counted and written down.

This matrix also has a common feature that can be seen only by putting it next to your chart. Of the year’s nine points, six are occupied by energies that aren’t on your chart at all: Strength, the World, the Lovers, the Hermit, the Tower, the Emperor. Only the Wheel (twice) and Judgement are familiar to you, plus Justice in the sum. Your main energy, the Chariot, isn’t in any point of the year’s matrix, and neither is your centre, the Hierophant. Two thirds of the year speak to you in an unfamiliar language.

Hence a practical conclusion. Your usual methods — speed, drive, a firm “how it should be” — are not cancelled in 2027, but they don’t get the background’s support either. Support goes to skills that are new for you: the endurance of Strength, the silence of the Hermit, the alliance of the Lovers, the breadth of the World, the building of the Emperor. The year is like a trip to a country whose language you know at an everyday level: you will manage to make yourself understood, and you will speak truly freely by the end of your stay if you practise every day. That is why every month in this report has one concrete task — that is the daily practice.
actions: Put three words of the year next to your workplace — “endurance, alliance, record” — and check against them before big decisions.
Define your “Hermit time”: two or three hours a week when you are unavailable to everyone and busy with the main undertaking of the year.
Start a “for June” list: write down there everything you want to break or rebuild earlier — in June the Tower rises into the plus.
Confirm every verbal agreement this year with a short email or message stating the terms.

chapters.h2: Your age in 2027: thirty-eight, then thirty-nine
chapters.conclusion: 2027 falls at the end of the decade of the Moon and in the middle of the transition from the personal purpose to the social one. The age ring holds the Tower until April and the Lovers from April, and both cards repeat the year’s matrix. The short arcanum of the year is 10, the Wheel: this energy stands both in the minuses of the year’s matrix and in the purpose that comes into force between the ages of 37 and 43.

cards.label: Short arcanum of 2027 and your social purpose
cards.caption: 7 + 10 + 11 = 28 → 10. One card for the whole year. It stands in both minus points of the year’s matrix and matches the social purpose that comes into force between the ages of 37 and 43.

blocks: Age colours the year no less than the year’s matrix. In “Prognostics” Lisovskaya describes several layers of time: a decade sets the tone for nine years, the five-year mark brings interim results, the yearly points of the ring suggest which energy is relevant in a particular year of life. The personal year, in her words, is counted from the birthday, so 2027 splits into two parts: until 7 October you are 38, after it 39.

timeline.text: The tone of the stretch is set by the Moon: fog, doubts, a strongly working imagination. 2027 is its next-to-last stretch: it is time to turn the fog into decisions.

blocks.h3: The ring agrees with the year

blocks: The most interesting thing here is the coincidence of two different calculations. The yearly points of the ring are calculated from the personal matrix, the year’s matrix from the sum of two dates, and they are not connected with each other. But for you they speak in unison. Until April the ring holds 16, the Tower, and it also stands in the weak spot of the year’s matrix. From April the ring moves to 6, the Lovers, who stand in the main plus of the year and in the result of its last third. The first third of the year passes under the sign of “don’t break things in the heat of the moment”, the rest of the year under the sign of choice and alliance.

Lisovskaya classes the Tower as a crisis energy together with 13 and 22: if such an energy stands on a year of life, serious changes can be expected that year, “not necessarily negative ones”. A change under the Tower goes more easily for someone who decided themselves what to rebuild and did it according to a plan. It is harder for someone who clings to what no longer holds.

blocks.h3: The Moon of the decade and the Strength of the year

blocks: Your decade from 30 to 40 is led by the Moon, an energy of unclarity and imagination. On this background 2027 lays Strength, and the combination is telling. The Moon makes the picture unclear, Strength teaches you not to twitch while it is unclear. In practice this means a rule of the year for big decisions: if the fog hasn’t lifted yet, the decision will wait, and endurance while waiting is also work — exactly the work the centre of the year teaches. The Moon also stands in your trigger point, through which you are easiest to influence. In August it rises into the plus of the month, and then the fog turns into imagination and ideas. The year shows that unclarity has two sides, and the second one can be chosen.

blocks.h3: The transition to forty

blocks: According to the book, the change from the personal purpose to the social one runs roughly from 37 to 43, and Lisovskaya calls this transition a midlife crisis: a person starts asking themselves whether they are on the right path. Your personal purpose — 5, the Hierophant — matches the centre of your matrix. Of such a case she writes that before forty a person needs to unfold through their centre: through knowledge, rules, the ability to teach and lead. The social purpose is 10, the Wheel: the ability to see the course of events, catch the moment, work with changes and with people from different places. In 2027 the Wheel stands in both minuses of the year’s matrix. It is as if the year lets you try out the new role in difficult conditions: what happens when you catch the moment, and what happens when you hope it will catch you.

The decade of the Moon ends in October 2028, and the last year of the decade begins with your birthday in October 2027. Lisovskaya writes that many people feel the last and first years of a cycle as a trial, and advises summing up, finishing and making new plans at the end of a cycle. For autumn 2027 this is direct advice: close what has dragged on since your early thirties and approach forty travelling light.

blocks.h3: The short arcanum of the year

blocks: If you have already seen your “arcanum of the year” on a separate page, that is a different, short calculation: day of birth, month of birth and the sum of the year’s digits — 7 + 10 + 11 = 28 → 10, the Wheel. Such a card is one for the whole year and the same for everyone with the same sum: it gives the general tone. The year’s matrix is nine points, three thirds and twelve months built from the full date of birth, and it shows where exactly in the year the plus, the minus and the weak spot are. In 2027 both methods converge on the Wheel, and that is convenient: the short arcanum retells the main risk and the main chance of the matrix in one word.
actions: Until 7 April 2027, don’t make irreversible decisions on a day when you are angry: the Tower on the ring and in the weak spot of the year makes such decisions costly.
From April, list the choices you have been putting off and give each a deadline — the Lovers on the ring and in the plus of the year support decisions made on time.
By your birthday in October 2027, write two columns: what to close before forty and what to take with you into the next decade.

chapters.h2: Three thirds of the year: Judgement, the Emperor, the Lovers
chapters.conclusion: January–April: sort through the results of earlier decisions and rebuild what doesn’t hold. May–August: build and consolidate order, keeping an even pace. September–December: choice and alliance, and the quality of that choice depends on how the first two thirds went.
blocks: In the year’s matrix Lisovskaya also calculates the block of purposes, but reads it in a special way: as three periods of four months each. The first two periods, in her words, are events and tasks to go through. The third shows the consequences of what was done at the start of the year and adds tasks of its own. Within the first period, pairs of points become its spiritual and material sides.

formula.caption: **20 + 4 = 24 → 6.** The result of winter and spring and the result of summer add up to autumn. The Lovers at the end of the year are a choice you will make relying on what you sorted through and built earlier.

blocks: This block has a rare feature: there isn’t a single new card in it. All the components and results — 16, 4, 20, 11, 20, 4, 20, 4, 6 — are taken from the year’s matrix itself. The year brings no outside themes into its thirds: it rearranges the cards of the matrix itself and shows when each of them comes to the fore.

blocks.h3: January–April: 16 the Tower and 4 the Emperor, result — 20 Judgement

blocks: The spiritual side of the first third is the Tower (the upper and lower points of the year, 6 + 10 = 16), the material side is the Emperor (the left and right points, 21 + 10 = 31 → 4). Together they give 20, Judgement. Translated into ordinary language: inside — a review of views and plans, outside — putting things in order, and in sum — sorting through the results of what you have done in recent years.

The Tower on the spiritual side is a signal that one of your former certainties has become outdated by the start of the year. It may be an idea about work, about how your relationships are arranged, about what is “normal” for you. The plus of the Tower in a forecast is rebuilding, renovation, renewal, leaving what has outlived itself; the minus is demolition without a plan. The Emperor on the material side holds the structure: structure, routine, responsibility, solving accumulated tasks. A good formula for the first third is “I rebuild according to a blueprint”.

Judgement as the result of the first third means actions from the past bring results, meetings with relatives, searching for a new occupation; be careful with people and situations from the past and with family quarrels. Judgement stands both in the lower right corner of the year and in your point of profit. January–April is a time to harvest earlier decisions and honestly look at which of them brought no harvest. By April you should have an answer to the question: what from the past do I continue, and what do I end.

ul: **Start:** a review of your affairs, obligations and money; a talk with family about what hasn’t been discussed for a long time; one rebuilding by plan — at work, at home or in your routine.
**Don’t:** break things off abruptly in anger, decide to “drop everything” in the first week of the year, return to people and projects from the past just because they called.

blocks.h3: May–August: 11 Strength and 20 Judgement, result — 4 the Emperor

blocks: The second third is made of Strength (the upper left and lower right corners, 9 + 20 = 29 → 11) and Judgement (the upper right and lower left corners, 16 + 4 = 20). The result is 4, the Emperor. Strength here is the centre of the year come to the fore: summer requires endurance and an even pace. Judgement for the second time in a row reminds you of results: what you sorted through in spring starts to bring results in summer. And the Emperor as the result is the main reward of this third: a stable structure you have built.

The plus of the Emperor in a forecast is ambition, promotion, a business of your own, a good position, stability, planning a move or a long trip, strengthening long-standing relationships, a family holiday. The minus is conflicts, rivalry, inspections, instability. Strength and the Emperor together mean power: over your time, your work, your area. Summer 2027 is good for taking responsibility and consolidating your position, and poorly suited for fighting over it. The difference shows in small things: the master of an area negotiates rules, a rival proves who is in charge.

ul: **Start:** the undertaking you prepared in spring — at an even pace, with a clear structure and distributed roles; a summer holiday planned in advance.
**Don’t:** compete for status, work without days off “for the sake of a sprint”, argue about precedence with people you will keep working with.

blocks.h3: September–December: result of the year — 6 the Lovers

blocks: The third third is the sum of the first two: 20 + 4 = 24 → 6. The Lovers stand in the upper point of the year, the main plus, and from April on your age ring. Now they become the result. Autumn is a time of choice: with whom you go further, which offer you accept, which contract you sign, which alliance you seal. The plus of the Lovers is partnership, contracts, help from outside, co-creation, many options; the minus is emotional instability, hurt feelings, unreasonable spending, missed details, competition and criticism.

How the first two thirds lead to the third. If in spring you sorted through the past (Judgement) and rebuilt by plan (the Tower in the plus), and in summer you consolidated order (the Emperor) and kept the pace (Strength), the autumn choice is made from a calm place: you know what you have and choose an ally for the task. If spring went on tearing things down in the heat of the moment and summer on fighting for precedence, by autumn the choice has to be made under pressure, and the minus of the Lovers — wavering and mistakes in details — gets more room. According to Lisovskaya, the third period shows exactly “the consequences of actions taken at the start of the year”.

ul: **Start:** negotiations on alliances and contracts that have ripened over the year; the choice you have been putting off; a plan for 2028.
**Don’t:** choose “out of pity” or by inertia, spend on emotion at the end of the year, sign without reading the details.

blocks.h3: How to keep this rhythm

blocks: It is handy to split the year into three stretches and ask one question at the end of each. At the end of April: what from the past have I finished and what am I continuing? At the end of August: what have I built and what does it rest on? At the end of December: with whom and with what am I going into the next year? These three questions are a condensed retelling of the whole block: Judgement, the Emperor, the Lovers.
actions: Put three dates in the calendar — 30 April, 31 August, 20 December — and on each answer the question of your third in writing.
In January, choose one rebuilding for the first third and describe its plan on one page before you start.
In May, distribute the roles in the main summer undertaking: who is responsible for what, including you — the Emperor and Strength love a clear structure.
In September, list the choices ahead in autumn and name two criteria for each by which you will decide.

chapters.h2: January: an inventory before the road
chapters.conclusion: January opens the year with its hint — Justice in the centre. The task of the month is an honest inventory: what you owe, what you promised, what you agreed on without deadlines. The second step is one calm conversation about terms, without fighting over who is in charge.

cards.label: Centre of January
cards.caption: The background of the month is an honest count and making things official. This card is the hint of all of 2027 and the main point of your material karma.

formula.caption: **8 = 8 = 8.** The year opens with the energy by which it hints at itself as a whole and which stands in the main point of your material karma. This coincides for roughly one date in eight.

blocks: Where to start the year? January has a very concrete answer: with a sheet of paper. Justice in the centre of the month matches the hint of the whole year, and its meaning is covered in the chapter on the year’s matrix: in 2027 everything that isn’t written down and counted holds badly. In January this hint is easiest to follow, because the year has no debts to you yet.

ul: **Money:** balances, regular expenses, debts and loans with payment dates.
**Promises:** to whom and what you promised to do this year — at work, at home, to friends.
**Agreements without deadlines:** everything that “we’ll sort out somehow”.
**Loose ends from last year:** things that drag on and lead nowhere.

blocks: The second task of January is one conversation about terms. For example, you have long been doing more than is written in your duties, or at home some agreement is broken again and again. In January it is worth raising this topic calmly, with figures from the inventory in hand. In the minus of the month stands the Emperor — struggle for power, rivalry, inspections. If the conversation starts turning into finding out who is in charge, that is the year’s first test of Strength. Naming the terms and not fighting for the chair — this year such a move pays off better than winning the argument.

Strength, the centre of the year, stands in the pure plus in January. A good moment to start the habit of the year: choose an undertaking you will run at an even pace, and training without spurts. Next to it in the plus is the Empress: taking care of yourself and your home is also January’s work. During these weeks people are drawn to your Sun, which appears on your chart three times: to openness, warmth, simple words.

The weak spot of the month is the World. It is the temptation to sign up for every course in the very first week and to promise trips and projects that depend on other people’s decisions. Write the big plans down as a separate list at the end of the inventory and come back to them in March, when it becomes clearer what you can count on.

blocks.h3: January and October

blocks: January and October share the centre, the upper left corner, both minus points and the lower right corner — that is how the calculation works. The inventory you make now will become a report in October: what is closed, what has grown, what is still hanging. Keep it.
actions: By 15 January, make an inventory under four headings: money, promises, agreements without deadlines, loose ends from last year.
Choose one agreement whose terms don’t suit you and discuss it calmly, with figures.
Name the undertaking you will run at an even pace all year, and decide how you will mark progress on it.
Write down big plans that depend on other people separately and come back to them in March.

chapters.conclusion: February holds the Hanged Man both in the centre and in the plus: it is a month of pause and a different angle of view. Its task is to close one outdated undertaking or habit and talk to elders about what you are deciding. New things are better started in March.

cards.label: Centre and plus of February
cards.caption: The Hanged Man twice: a pause, a change of priorities, fresh ideas from an unexpected side. On your chart it stands at the entrance to relationships and in the parents’ point.

blocks: After the January inventory the Chariot wants to drive off at once. February suggests first looking at what you have gathered upside down. In Lisovskaya’s list the Hanged Man means a change of priorities, clearing out space and contacts, fresh and even innovative ideas, rest and solitude. Its minus is a state of suspension, stagnation, self-sacrifice and, as a separate line, “starting something new without letting go of the old”. In February it stands twice, in the centre and in the pure plus, and Lisovskaya advises paying attention to repetitions within a matrix. This repetition says it directly: let go first.
What you can let go of in February:

ul: a project that has dragged on for six months and is no longer needed by anyone, including you;
an obligation taken on out of politeness;
chats, subscriptions and meetings that leave nothing but tiredness;
things that take up space “just in case”.

blocks: The empty space that appears afterwards is filled by the Hanged Man: fresh ideas need somewhere to arrive.

items.label: You: entrance to relationships and the tail

formula.caption: **12 = 12.** The centre of the month matches the start of your relationship line and karmic tail. February touches what you want from closeness and where you may be used to putting up with things.

blocks: The Hanged Man also stands in your inner point to the left of the centre, which Lisovskaya calls the parents’ point. And the support of the month is the Hierophant, your centre: elders, a mentor, study. February is good for a conversation with an elder in the family or with a person whose experience you trust. The topic doesn’t have to be difficult. You can simply tell them what you are deciding now and ask how it looks from the outside. The Hanged Man is the card of the inverted view, and someone else’s view works here as such an inversion.

The Lovers, the main plus of the year, land in February in the point of trials: swings, hurt feelings, pressure from different sides. If a choice comes up in February — in relationships or at work — let it ripen until March. A decision made from a state of suspension usually turns out to be a decision of fatigue.

The weak spot of the month is the Fool. In a forecast it means the new, freedom, a journey, and in the minus chaos, frivolity and vague promises. After a pause the urge to “drop everything and leave” is especially strong; for February it is better to write it down and put it off. The month shows people Judgement: an honest conversation about the past. If someone from the past turns up, meet them with your eyes open.

blocks.h3: February and November

blocks: In November a similar base will return: the Hanged Man in the centre, the Hierophant in the support, the Lovers in the minus. The February pause clears space before the start, the November one helps make the last choice of the year.
actions: By the end of February, close one undertaking, obligation or habit that has outlived itself.
Clear out one space completely: your desk, a wardrobe, your phone or your list of subscriptions.
Talk to an elder in the family or a mentor about a decision you are considering, and write down what you heard.
Put a choice that came up in February off until mid-March.

chapters.conclusion: March brings back your energy: the Chariot stands in the centre and in the support of the month. It is the best month of the first third to start the main undertaking of the year and find an ally for it. Terms go on paper, and your rules stay yours and don’t become rules for everyone.

cards.label: Centre and support of March
cards.caption: The Chariot twice: movement, trips, a team, a launch. On your chart it is the most frequent energy — it appears there four times.

formula.caption: **7 = 7 = 7.** The Chariot repeats within the month and matches your main energy. In the year of Strength, March is the month when driving fast is allowed.

blocks: After the inventory and the pause, the year gives you acceleration. In Lisovskaya’s forecast the Chariot means great activity, trips, a big project, a team and delegation, partnership, starting a new undertaking, a good time for sport; in the minus — lack of restraint, unjustified risk, rivalry and arguments. In March it stands in the centre and in the upper left corner, and both positions speak your native language.

What to launch? What you named in January and cleared space for in February. The main undertaking of the year doesn’t have to be a business or a team. It may be a project at work, a move to another department, study, a sports goal, a renovation, a move, a book you have long intended to write. What matters is this: the undertaking has a first step in March and a checkpoint at the end of April.

ul: **Who is with me.** At least one ally: a colleague, a partner, a coach, someone close who knows about the goal.
**What is on paper.** Deadlines, roles, money — written down at once, while everyone is happy and agreeing is easy.
**How I’ll know I’m moving.** One figure or sign by which movement will be visible at the end of April.

blocks: Death in the upper point, which is also the entrance to your money line, suggests the form of the start: finish something so that the new can get going. It is good if the March launch rests on an undertaking honestly closed in February. In the minus of the month is Justice, that is, papers and terms. In six months it will be much harder to argue about what was “meant” than to write it down now.

The weak spot of March is the Hierophant, your centre. When everything is moving, you want everyone to move by your rules. A familiar scene: you explain to a colleague or someone close how to do it properly, they do it their own way, and half a day goes on an argument about method while the work stands still. The rules that help you think don’t have to become rules for everyone travelling alongside you.

The people point of March matches the year — the World: a wide circle, people from other cities and countries, external connections. March is good for letting people beyond your usual circle learn about your undertaking.

**What to put off in March.** Arguments about method and about who is in charge of the new undertaking. In March the winner is whoever got moving, and working out how it should have been done can wait until the April check.

blocks.h3: March and December

blocks: In December the Chariot in the centre and in the support, Justice in the minus and the Hierophant in the weak spot will repeat. By December the March start will have come full circle, and it is handy to measure the result of the year by how far it has got.
actions: In March, start the main undertaking of the year and set a checkpoint for the end of April.
Find at least one ally for it and tell them about the goal.
Write down the deadlines, roles and money for every March agreement.
When you feel like teaching everyone how to do it properly, ask a question of the person doing it differently and hear the answer out.

chapters.h2: April: the dress rehearsal of the year
chapters.conclusion: For this date April almost copies the year’s matrix: Strength in the centre, the Hermit in the support, the Wheel in both minuses, Judgement in the corner, Justice in the sum. The month is for checking whether your chosen way of carrying the year works. On 7 April the age ring moves from the Tower to the Lovers.

cards.label: Centre of April and centre of the year
cards.caption: Strength in the centre of the month matches the centre of the year. April is a scaled-down copy of 2027 on which it is handy to check what works.

blocks: In a non-leap year, April is close to the year’s matrix by the way the calculation works — this happens for many dates, and it is not a personal discovery. But you can use it personally. You have six matches: the centre (Strength), the support (the Hermit), both minus points (the Wheel), the lower right corner (Judgement) and the sum of the month (Justice). April is 2027 in miniature.
Such a miniature is handy for checking yourself. Recall the main undertaking you started in March and answer three questions:

ol: Am I keeping an even pace, or am I dashing in spurts again?
Do I have time for myself that nobody takes away?
Am I repeating old mistakes with money: impulse spending, decisions “on luck”, trusting those who haven’t earned it?

blocks: If the answer to all three questions is calm, you can run the rest of the year the same way. If not, April is a convenient time to correct course: before summer, when the load will grow.

A plus the year doesn’t have is Temperance; it stands in the lower left corner of your chart. In Lisovskaya’s list this is creativity, harmony, a trip to nature, profit or breaking even, a circle of like-minded people. After March’s speed, April asks for a change of rhythm: a trip out of town, work without hurry, an evening with people on the same wavelength.

The Wheel in both minuses sounds more distinctly in April than in other months. Here it is easiest to fall into a repetition: a familiar situation unfolds by the old scenario, and you only recognise it halfway through. Noticing, naming it and taking one step differently — that is enough. The weak spot of April is the Lovers: a choice under pressure, wavering between two options. If you are being rushed with a decision, name a date in May, when the Lovers come into the centre. April shows people the Fool: easy acquaintances are fine, easy promises are not.

What a repetition looks like in practice: you are again invited to take part in a venture with a person who has already let you down once; again you want to quiet anxiety with a purchase; again an argument flares up at home that you have already heard word for word. Recognising such a situation at the start is already half the work. The other half is to make at least one move in it in a new way: decline, put the purchase off for a week, stay silent where you would usually answer back.

blocks.h3: 7 April: the ring changes

blocks: April closes the first third of the year, whose result is Judgement; it also stands in the lower right corner of the month. And on 7 April, at thirty-eight and a half, the age ring moves from the Tower to the Lovers. The weak spot of the first third stays behind; ahead is a time of choice and alliances. You can mark this day with a small ritual: write down what you leave in the first third and what you take further.
actions: Answer April’s three questions and fix one thing that isn’t working.
Take a trip to nature, or at least one day without hurry.
If you are being rushed with an important choice, name a decision date in May.
On 7 April, write down what you leave in the first third of the year and what you take with you.

chapters.conclusion: May puts the Lovers, the main plus of the year, in the centre: a time to make the postponed decision and formalise it. In the plus of the month stand your talent point and your point of profit, so May is good for naming a price for your work. The weak spot is your speed at the peak of success.

cards.label: Centre of May
cards.caption: The Lovers — choice, alliance, contracts. This card is the plus of the whole year, the result of September–December and the point of your age ring from April.

blocks: In April you were advised to put choice off; in May its time has come. The Lovers in the centre mean choice, partnership, contracts (their meanings are covered in the chapter on the year’s matrix), and in May they sound in three voices: the centre of the month, the plus of the year and your age ring. If something has been waiting for a decision since winter — an offer, a move, an agreement with someone close — May is the best month of the second third for it.

formula.caption: **15 = 15.** The upper point of May matches your additional talent above the centre. The second plus of the month, Judgement, matches your point of profit.

blocks: The Devil in Lisovskaya’s forecast means earnings and payouts, sales, getting a job or a big promotion, passion and success. In May it stands in the pure plus and matches your additional talent. Next to it is Judgement, your point of profit: the results of past actions and expansion. Together they suggest that what you know how to do can be offered at a higher price in May, and the grounds for it are what you have already done.

A good May scene: you come to your manager, client or partner with a proposal that names a price, not “whatever you can spare”. If you are employed, this may be a conversation about salary, about a new role, or about part of your work finally becoming paid. A bad May scene: you agree to the first offer because it arrived, and then work on someone else’s terms for six months.

The minus of May is the Empress. After a hard spring you want to reward yourself, and what you earned goes on comfort faster than it came in. A simple rule for this month: set aside part of every payment at once, before deciding what to spend the rest on.

In May people need the Hierophant from you: to explain, to teach, to give advice. And the weak spot is the Chariot, your main energy. The danger of May is that everything works out and you want to speed up even more. It is exactly at the peak that it is easy to take an unnecessary risk and become harsh with those who can’t keep up.

If you work without subordinates and without clients, May’s “name a price” may look more modest and still be real: ask for a duty you have long carried silently to be written into your role or taken off you; agree at home on who pays for what; sell something lying idle at a fair price. The point is the same — your contribution stops being free by default.
**What to put off in May.** Big purchases “as a reward for spring”. First the decision and the price, then gifts to yourself — from what remains after the set-aside part.
actions: Make the decision that has been waiting since winter and formalise it in writing.
Prepare a conversation about the price of your work — with your manager, client or partner — and have it in May.
Set aside a fixed part of every May payment at once.
Hold one meeting where you explain or teach.

chapters.conclusion: In June the weak spot of the year, the Tower, rises into the plus, and the Wheel comes into the centre. The task of the month is to rebuild by plan one thing that doesn’t hold: your home, your routine, a work process. The trial is your own “the proper way”, which keeps you from noticing a new chance.

cards.label: Centre of June
cards.caption: The Wheel — a chance and a repeat of old scenarios at the same time. On your chart it is your spiritual task, your main talent.

cards.label: Plus of June
cards.caption: The Tower in the pure plus — rebuilding, renovation, renewal. In June the weak spot of the year works for you.

blocks: What creaks in your life? June is the month when it can be fixed. The Tower stands in the weak spot all year, but in June it finds itself in the pure plus, and its positive side from the chapter on the year’s matrix — renovation, rebuilding, renewal, leaving what has outlived itself — gets support. Everything you were advised not to break in the heat of the moment in the first third can now be rebuilt calmly.
How to choose June’s rebuilding:

ul: it has been due for a long time, and you put it off for lack of time, without doubting that it is needed;
it has a one-page plan and a deadline;
after it, moving will become easier — the Fool, the second plus of the month, hints that you rebuild for the sake of freedom.

blocks: It may be a literal renovation, moving your workplace, reassembling your daily routine, replacing old equipment, updating your portfolio or CV. The scale doesn’t matter; the plan does.

formula.caption: **10 = 10 = 10.** The Wheel, which stands in the minus all year, comes into the centre in June and becomes the background. Your main talent, a sense of the moment, gets a month with both sides at once.

blocks: The Wheel in the centre is your talent at full volume. A chance you notice in June is worth accepting if it continues what you have been building since spring. A chance that suggests dropping everything and starting from scratch is better tested by time: the Wheel in the centre brings an opportunity and an old scenario in new packaging equally readily.

The trial of June is the Hierophant, your centre, in the lower point. Of its minuses in Lisovskaya’s list, one is the main one for June: “a person doesn’t see new paths and offers”. A scene: you are offered a different way of working, a different role or just a different holiday route, and your first reaction is “that’s not how we do things”. In June it is worth putting this reaction through a question: does the rule still help, or does it already get in the way?

The people point is the Lovers: in summer people expect involvement and warmth from you. The weak spot is Justice, the hint of the year. In a vulnerable position it turns into a wish to sort out who is right where things need fixing.
actions: Choose one rebuilding for June and do it according to a one-page plan.
Test every June chance with a question: does it continue the spring undertaking or suggest dropping everything?
Write out five of your “the proper way” rules and mark the ones that got in your way this year.
In an argument, first ask yourself what needs fixing, and start with that.

chapters.h2: July: the year comes to your centre
chapters.conclusion: In July the centre of the month matches your personal centre — the Hierophant. It is the month of your role: explaining, passing on experience, gathering loved ones, showing what you have done. The trial is the Chariot, which stands both in the minus and in relations with people.

cards.label: Centre of July
cards.caption: The Hierophant — mentor, tradition, learning, family celebrations. On your chart it stands in the centre and matches your personal purpose.

formula.caption: **5 = 5.** The only month of the year where the centre of the month equals your personal centre. July speaks your native language.

blocks: Of the twelve months, only July has a centre that matches yours. The Hierophant stands in your centre and in your personal purpose, and of such a match Lisovskaya writes that before forty a person needs to unfold through their centre. In a forecast the Hierophant means a mentor or the role of a mentor, learning, public speaking, meetings with relatives, family celebrations, getting out of stagnation; in the minus — a false path and a false leader, problems with documents, fanaticism. July gives a direct occasion for your role. What it can look like:

ul: you explain to a newcomer at work what took you years to learn;
you gather the family for a celebration you have long put off;
you take a course that has long been calling you, or start teaching someone yourself — a child, a friend, a colleague;
you talk about your work where people are ready to listen.

blocks: In all these scenes you are in your place, and people feel it.

The plus of July is the Star, your point of inspiration, and the Lovers. In Lisovskaya’s list the Star means recognition, promotion, finishing studies, qualifications, allies, new horizons, a lucky meeting. In July it stands twice, in the plus and in the lower right corner: what you have done may be noticed. Help it along — show the result of the first half of the year without waiting for people to find it themselves. The Lovers next to it add alliance: recognition comes more easily through partners.

The Chariot, your main energy, occupies two positions in July: the point of trials and the point of people. People need your energy and your leadership, and it is also the main risk of the month: at the peak of your strength someone slow starts to irritate you. July’s test of Strength is to lead without rushing people. The Hierophant suggests the form: a teacher shows and waits.
The weak spot is the Hermit, the support of the year: the wish to vanish from everyone after busy weeks. Resting is worth it; vanishing is not — July’s connections rest on presence.

**What to put off in July.** Harsh conversations with those who can’t keep up with you, and new big commitments. July is for your role and recognition; new loads are better taken on in September, after the August pause.
actions: Hold one session, review or conversation where you share what you do best.
Show the result of the first half of the year to those for whom it matters.
Gather your loved ones for a get-together you have long put off.
When leading people, set the pace by the slowest participant.

chapters.h2: August: a holiday that counts as work
chapters.conclusion: August holds the Hermit in the centre and in the minus: it needs a pause chosen consciously, with a budget and without withdrawing into isolation. The Moon, which usually unsettles you, stands in the plus in August and turns silence into ideas.

cards.label: Centre of August
cards.caption: The Hermit — time for yourself, a holiday, focus, personal boundaries. In the year’s matrix it is the support.

blocks: What makes a good August different from a bad one? The amount of rest has nothing to do with it. The Hermit stands in the centre of the month and in the lower point, and the difference between its plus and minus (they are covered in the chapter on the year’s matrix) comes down to one sign: whether you chose the pause or fell into it.

head: A good August
A bad August
rows: the holiday is planned, work is switched off for that time
you didn’t go anywhere and aren’t talking to anyone
two weeks on one undertaking without distractions
the budget is drawn up before the month starts
big purchases on a wave of mood

blocks: Lisovskaya names the Hermit’s minus in money directly — financial restrictions. And the Wheel in the weak spot adds the temptation of “I’ll get lucky”. For August it is better to draw up a budget in advance and not bet money on luck.

formula.caption: **18 = 18.** The Moon, which stands in your trigger point and sets the whole decade from 30 to 40, rises into the pure plus in August.

blocks: The Moon stands in your point through which a person is easiest to influence, and leads the whole decade from 30 to 40. In the plus of a forecast it means inspiration, a creative breakthrough, a pause and calm, work on yourself, and also “the truth came out”. In August the Hermit’s silence and the Moon’s imagination work together: answers to questions that stayed in the fog all year may come by themselves if you give them room. Keep a notebook handy.

What August’s “the truth came out” might look like. On the third day of the holiday, when your head finally empties, it becomes clear that you are holding on to one of the spring plans out of stubbornness. Or that the conversation you have avoided for six months is actually needed. Such an understanding doesn’t require immediate action: with the Hermit in the centre it is enough to write it down and bring it into September, where changes are supported.

Justice stands twice in August — in the support and in the people point: clarity is expected of you, and you have the right to expect it of others. The month closes the second third, whose result is the Emperor. By the end of August you can see whether what you built in summer holds without your daily push. If it holds, summer went according to plan. If everything rests only on you, the autumn Lovers will ask you to share out the load.
actions: Plan a holiday or two weeks of work on one undertaking, and switch off everything unnecessary for that time.
Draw up August’s budget before it starts.
Keep a notebook for ideas for the whole month.
Check the main undertaking of the year: which part of it works without your involvement.

chapters.conclusion: September puts Death in the centre — it stands at the entrance to your money line. The task of the month is one conscious change in money: remove what doesn’t work and open something new. Strength, the centre of the year, goes into the minus and the weak spot in September: the main risk is overload.

cards.label: Centre of September
cards.caption: Death — completion and renewal, “finances need changes”. On your chart it is the entrance to the money line.

items.label: You: entrance to the money line

formula.caption: **13 = 13.** The centre of the month matches the point through which, according to Lisovskaya, money enters your life and through which it is also blocked.

blocks: Lisovskaya calls the entrance to the money line “an entrance and a block at the same time”: its energy opens the flow and closes it if you behave wrongly. You have Death there — completion and renewal. In a forecast Death means a new job, a project, a transfer, changes, “finances need changes”, “things have got moving”; in the minus — losses, loss of funding, a return to the past, stagnation. In September it is in the centre, and which side you get is largely your choice: a change you carry out yourself goes along the plus. The month is handy to split into four weeks.

ol: **First week.** List all sources of income and regular expenses for the last three months.
**Second.** Find one link that eats more than it gives: a subscription, a loan, unfavourable terms, a project with no return.
**Third.** Remove it or rewrite the terms.
**Fourth.** Direct what has been freed up into something new: study, a new source of income, a reserve.

blocks: An example of such a change. For the third year you have been paying for something you don’t use, or keeping a project that eats your weekends and brings almost nothing, or working on terms agreed when you knew less. One such link removed in September frees up both money and energy — and that is exactly the renewal through which, according to Lisovskaya, your entrance to money opens.

The plus of September is the Sun, which appears on your chart three times, and the Wheel. In Lisovskaya’s list the Sun means activity, opening a business, changing jobs, a period of opportunities, getting out of a crisis, a good acquaintance. The Wheel in the upper left corner makes this a rare month when your main talent stands in the pure plus, and your instinct for the moment is supported in September. It is a good time to offer yourself in a new place or launch a new source of income.

In September Strength stands in the point of trials and in the weak spot, and here you can see the face of its minus: workaholism and burnout, conflicts, manipulation. After August, autumn starts abruptly, and it is easy to take on three times more than you can sustain. The danger sign is simple: you stop getting enough sleep and start demanding that people keep up with you.

In September people need a quiet you: their point holds the Hermit — calm expertise and the ability not to rush. And both lower corners of the month are about money: your attitude to the material and your point of profit. One more confirmation that September is a month of money decisions.

**What to put off in September.** New commitments beyond the set limit, even very attractive ones. If an offer is really good, it will survive a conversation in October, when autumn’s starting rush is over.
actions: Carry out the change in money over September’s four weeks.
Use the plus of the month for a new source of income or a new place.
Set a workload limit: how many projects or hours a week you take on in September.
When you notice you are rushing people, ask how you can help them.

chapters.h2: October: a report on the January inventory
chapters.conclusion: October repeats January’s base and puts Judgement — your point of profit — in the plus. The task of the month is to check the January inventory against life and close what has stalled. On 7 October you turn 39: the last year of the decade of the Moon begins.

cards.label: Plus of October
cards.caption: Judgement in the pure plus — the results of past actions. On your chart it is the middle of the money line, the point of profit.

blocks: October and January share a base: Justice in the centre, the Empress in the support, the Emperor in the minus. The difference is in the plus. In January it held Strength — a habit you were starting. In October it holds Judgement — a time to look at results. October is the month for which it was worth picking up a sheet of paper in January.

head: What was in the inventory
October’s question
rows: what has been paid off, what has grown
what has been kept, what it is time to honestly cancel
what is closed, what has dragged on for nine months

formula.caption: **20 = 20.** The upper point of October matches the middle of your money line: profit comes from what was done earlier.

blocks: Judgement in the plus is the harvest. If in spring you sorted through the results of past years and in summer you built, in October you can see what has grown. The second plus is the Empress. In a forecast this means the fruits of work done, abundance, stability, support, home, a wish coming true; in the minus — missed opportunities, cooling, forced economy. A good October is a month when you acknowledge the result and enjoy it without belittling it.

The Empress also stands in the weak spot, and this repetition warns: abundance easily turns into excess. Your birthday makes the temptation understandable. It is worth celebrating; turning the celebration into a hole in the budget is not. If in October someone disputes your result or your place, remember how in January you dealt with the Emperor in the minus: terms are named, the chair is not shared. The people point is the Wheel: easy acquaintances and news. The mistake of this point is to invest in someone you have known for a week.
**What to put off in October.** New debts for the celebration and investment decisions on a wave of success. Count the harvest first, then distribute it.

blocks.h3: Thirty-nine

blocks: On 7 October you turn 39, and the last year of the decade led by the Moon begins. Lisovskaya writes that at the end of a ten-year cycle everything started ten years earlier should either bring results or come to an end, and that this is a time to sum up and make new plans. A birthday in the year of Strength is an occasion for a short, honest review: what of what you started after thirty has grown, what it is time to close, what you want to bring to forty. The age ring holds the Lovers right up to your fortieth birthday, and this year’s choice is part of the transition.
actions: Check the January inventory against October’s four questions.
Close one stalled matter: pay, formalise, return or reach a final agreement.
Set your birthday budget in advance.
On your birthday, write three lines: what has grown since thirty, what it is time to close, what you are bringing to forty.

chapters.conclusion: November brings the Hanged Man back to the centre: a month of review before the end of the year. The Lovers, the result of autumn, stand in the minus, so the main choice of the year comes hardest. The task of the month is to make it slowly and finally, and to finish what got stuck at ninety per cent.

cards.label: Plus of November
cards.caption: The World in the pure plus — completion, a wide horizon, trips, freedom. The card that closes the circle of the major arcana.

blocks: The pause you took in February returns with a different task. In February the Hanged Man cleared space before the start. In November it helps you look at the almost-lived year from the outside before making the last choice.

formula.caption: **6 = 6.** The Lovers, the result of the last third of the year, stand in the point of trials in November. The choice that the whole autumn led up to comes hardest this month.

blocks: If autumn has brought you to a choice — whom to work with, whom to live with, which offer to accept — November makes it harder: swings, pressure from different sides, missed details. The matrix doesn’t say what to choose. It suggests a way.

ol: Write out the options, including “change nothing”.
For each, name what you fear and what you hope for.
Let the list sit for a week.
Discuss it with someone who looks from the outside — that is the Hanged Man’s move.
Decide on a calm day and formalise it at once.

blocks: The plus of November is the World and the Hierophant. The World is the card of completion, and in November it supports everything that is brought to an end: a project stuck at ninety per cent, a trip long talked about, a course that broadens your view. The Hierophant next to it adds a teacher: it is good to learn from someone who knows more than you.

In the people point stands Strength, the centre of the year. Those around you expect from you what the year has been teaching: calm strength and the ability to carry a load. If you have mastered it, November will show it through people — they will come to you for support. The weak spot is the Emperor; among its minuses Lisovskaya names conflicts, rivalry, instability. Towards the end of the year this easily takes the form of a wish to take everything under control, and control starts interfering with what should ripen by itself.

A November scene with people: a colleague, a friend or someone from the family comes to you with a problem that has overwhelmed them. A person with four Chariots usually offers a plan at once and takes the matter on themselves. November’s Strength suggests something else: hear them out to the end, ask two questions and help the person see their own next step. The support people look for in you in November is the calm with which you hold someone else’s anxiety.

If the review shows that some structure doesn’t hold (the Tower stands in the corner of the month), it is better to rebuild it in the new year and according to a plan. In November it is enough to write it down honestly.
actions: Make the main choice of autumn by the five steps of a slow choice.
Finish one undertaking stuck at ninety per cent.
Plan a trip or a course that broadens your view.
Write down what didn’t hold up in 2027 and put off rebuilding it until January.

chapters.h2: December: settle accounts and set a route
chapters.conclusion: December, like March, holds the Chariot in the centre and in the support: your speed returns towards the end of the year. Its best use is to settle the accounts of 2027 and lay a route for 2028. The month shows people the Empress: generosity and warmth balance December’s rush.

cards.label: Centre and support of December
cards.caption: The Chariot twice — movement, plans, a team. The year that began after your year of the Chariot ends with it.

blocks: In March the Chariot launched the main undertaking of the year; in December you can see where it has got to. The energy of the month is handy to split into two columns.

head: Close by 20 December
Lay out for 2028
rows: the first step of each goal
one empty slot for the unexpected
